create.name: De-Tong Ling Retreat Centre
create.bio:
Set in about 1,300 acres of bush on Kangaroo Island, South Australia, De-Tong Ling is a Tibetan Buddhist retreat centre of the FPMT network. Its Tibetan name, which means place of bliss and emptiness, was given by Lama Zopa Rinpoche in 1988 after students offered him the land, and the centre opened formally in 1994 once Khensur Kangurwa Lobsang Thubten Rinpoche had blessed the site. A large stupa looks out over the sea, and the centre's teachers include the Adelaide-born monk Ven. Thubten Dondrub, who chairs its committee, and the nun Ven. Tenzin Tsapel.

The centre is built for silence. Four private retreat houses of rammed earth and mud brick, powered by the sun and fed by rainwater, host solitary retreats of any length, with a manager handling supplies so that retreatants can keep the Buddhist precepts undisturbed; longer stays require earlier retreat experience. A group retreat facility hosts several led retreats each year, among them an annual lam-rim retreat, and can be hired by other contemplative groups. Members support the land and receive discounts on retreats.

courses.title: Mindfulness, Ethics & One-Pointed Calm Abiding
courses.description: A six-day residential retreat with Ven. Tenzin Tsapel, open to beginners and experienced meditators of any faith, drawing on the fourth chapter of Maitreya's Ornament for Clear Realisation. Days combine meditation instruction, guided sessions and discussion.

courses.title: Individual Retreat
courses.description: Solitary retreat in one of four self-contained houses in the bush, with discreet support from the centre manager for shopping and supplies. Applicants keep the five precepts and a vegetarian diet, and those planning more than a week need earlier isolated retreat experience.

courses.title: Member Mandala
courses.description: Five levels of yearly membership that support the retreat land, giving access to a members' forum and, at most levels, a discount on solo and group retreats.
courses.price: Parasol $10 p.a.; Endless Knot $108 p.a.; Golden Fish $200 p.a.; Treasure Vase $600 p.a.; Lotus $1,108 p.a.
